answer: the banana (in the culinary sense; botanically the tomato)
why: By FAOSTAT 2022 the banana (135 Mt) is the most-produced fruit in the everyday sense, ahead of watermelon (100 Mt) and apple (96 Mt); mango is far behind (59 Mt). But the tomato, botanically a fruit, is harvested in larger amounts (186 Mt), and the card says "Frucht". The wording now asks for fruit in the everyday sense ("Obst"); tomato is accepted in the notes for the botanical reading.

Cockroaches (insects) do not descend from dinosaurs. The oldest cockroach-like fossils (roachoids) are Carboniferous (~320 Ma); true crown-group cockroaches appear in the Late Jurassic, so "oldest known cockroach fossils" was loose. The wording now says "cockroach-like fossils".
